name: har-atlas
description: HAR (HTTP Archive) files from browser DevTools: summary, failed and slowest requests with timings. Pro: host breakdown, caching and compression review. Works offline.

commands.title: HAR Atlas: Show Caching And Compression (Pro)
HAR Atlas: Remove Licence From This Machine

walkthroughs.title: Get started with HAR Atlas
walkthroughs.description: Open a sample HAR file, see the summary, the failed and the slowest requests, and try the Pro host breakdown and caching review in the free 14-day trial.

steps.title: Open a sample file
steps.description:
HAR Atlas reads HAR files: the JSON file a browser's network panel saves with every request, its timings, sizes and headers. Open the invented sample to follow along, or open a HAR file of your own.
[Open Sample File](command:harAtlas.openSample)

steps.title: Run Show Summary
steps.description:
The whole capture at a glance: how many requests went to how many hosts, how much was transferred, how many failed and the browser's page load time. The report opens as a new Markdown document; your file is not changed.
[Show Summary](command:harAtlas.showSummary)

steps.title: Use the other free reports
steps.description:
Every free report works without a key, an account or a network connection: Show Failed Requests, Show Slowest Requests.
[Show Failed Requests](command:harAtlas.showFailedRequests)
[Show Slowest Requests](command:harAtlas.showSlowestRequests)

steps.title: Try Pro free for 14 days
steps.description:
The first Pro command you run starts a free 14-day trial on this computer, with no key and no network: Show Host Breakdown, Show Caching And Compression.
[Show Host Breakdown](command:harAtlas.showHostBreakdown)

steps.title: Licence and help
steps.description:
Buy Pro (Personal USD 19, Business USD 39 per user), enter a key, see the licence status, or report a problem.
[Show Licence Status](command:harAtlas.licenceStatus)
[Report A Problem](command:harAtlas.reportProblem)

harAtlas.maxFileSizeMB.markdownDescription: Largest file (in MB) a report reads, up to 50 MB (VS Code passes files only up to 50 MB to extensions). Larger files are refused with a message.

harAtlas.openReportsAsPreview.markdownDescription: Open each report in the Markdown preview as well as in a new editor.
